conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces overall portfolio risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and underperforming assets, while maintaining a focus on quality and income. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4% per month by leaning into leverage and concentration. It utilizes leveraged ETFs and high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware that this approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.

income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month through income-focused ETFs. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable monthly distributions over growth, cutting leverage and high-beta names. Remember that distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
